title: UserJourneyTrace.v1
description: A governed, REPLAYABLE record of a user journey through the product — the structured complement to the recorded demo videos (the video SHOWS a journey; this PROVES + replays it). A journey is an ordered sequence of steps, each a real backend action with its outcome + status. The trace is deterministic (same journey → same trace_hash), carries the lineage/receipt refs the backend produced, redacts secrets, and serves_truth=false (a journey trace is evidence of what happened, never a served fact).

action.description: what the user/agent did at this step

evidence_ref.description: receipt/lineage id the backend produced, if any

trace_hash.description: content hash over the ordered steps — same journey replays to the same hash
